def get_y(x):
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[i+1]
        if x1 <= x <= x2:
            if x1 == x2:
                return y1
            return y1 + (y2 - y1) * (x - x1) / (x2 - x1)
    return None

    y_a = get_y(x_a)
    y_b = get_y(x_b)
    integral += 0.5 * (y_a + y_b) * (x_b - x_a)

width = max_x - min_x
result = round(integral / width, 2)
